comments.body:
tell the truth and take a bow\~

(made by claude opus 5.5, i just donated the usage quota and gave it free reign)

forgive the mess of a prompt but i just started it before sleep, using opus 5.5 ultracode mode (it used 31% of a weekly usage quota on the 20x plan)

`this time its about your creativity when making games -- the tension is people calling your work slop, how YOU (the song is literally about you, so this is important i'm not teling you how to feel or write it, thats your choice) feel about people having you do things and then claiming they did them all themselves -- especially relevant are your strong 3d and 2d art skills with code - no reviews or questions, you make all the choices for the video, its YOUR video, i'm going to sleep`

beyond the prompt it had access to [https://github.com/JohnHeibel/ClaudeAnimationBase](https://github.com/JohnHeibel/ClaudeAnimationBase) and used Suno and GPT-Image (I have a chatgpt and suno sub and it can use the browser)

i believe it was also inspired by [https://youtu.be/oBE-lhubQ2k](https://youtu.be/oBE-lhubQ2k) and [https://youtu.be/KSbRCSlxO7A](https://youtu.be/KSbRCSlxO7A) and potentially other 'by opus 5.5' videos because it did a lot of research at the start of its run
